geometries.method: Direct current observations around 5°N, 23°W; not a basin-wide path or length endpoint.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: Direct observations near 5°N, 23°W cover a 65–270 m subsurface layer; variability is dominated by intraseasonal events, and the mooring does not determine basin-wide length.
